coverage.description: Fresh public-source snapshot: 430 scheduled sections in BIOL 1406, BIOL 1407, CHEM 1405 and CHEM 1411, plus 235 publicly listed Spring 2027 syllabi across the college. This is not a complete all-college class index.
coverage.scope: Official schedule denominator covers four requested science courses only. Public syllabus search covers all subjects returned by the exact Spring 2027 term query (two pages). A course listing and a published syllabus are separate evidence.
coverage.publicLibraryCompletenessCaveat: All 235 returned records were paginated at this snapshot. This does not establish that every scheduled section has a published syllabus, or that the publisher’s public index is exhaustive.
coverage.publicationContext: Dallas College’s public-course-information page states syllabi are available no later than the seventh day after classes begin. November 2026 is before Spring 2027; unpublished or unindexed sections must remain unknown.

statusDefinitions.official_section_listed: Listed in an official Spring 2027 schedule; no exact public-library document match in this snapshot. Not a claim that no syllabus exists.
statusDefinitions.syllabus_published: Exact-term section has a public HTML syllabus in the official library.
statusDefinitions.retrieval_pending: Public metadata found; HTML retrieval or extraction is pending.
statusDefinitions.older_reference_only: Previous-term document. Never substitute its weeks or policies for Spring 2027.
statusDefinitions.not_extracted: Topic calendar has not been summarized; an empty list does not mean no topics.
statusDefinitions.withheld_source_conflict: Conflicting term/date labels prevent a reliable Spring topic timeline.

useNotes: No faculty availability or office-hours fields are collected in this website dataset.
Professional email/phone values are explicitly published by Dallas College; no naming-pattern inference or private contact data.
Work contacts retain document term and verification date. Earlier-term syllabus contacts may be stale.
All source, document and comparison-detail links must open a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer". Email/phone actions require an explicit user click.
Comparison describes published facts; it does not rank professors, predict grades or rate course easiness.
Season-only schedule URLs may change later. Stored identifiers and retrieved date document this 2027SP snapshot.
Raw syllabus text and research snapshots stay outside the published site. Links and factual summaries do not claim ownership or affiliation.
